terbaru.judul: Integrable cellular automata on finite fields of order $2^n$
terbaru.pelajaran: We show that these conditions become remarkably streamlined in characteristic two.

terbaru.judul: Quantum Cellular Automata: The Group, the Space, and the Spectrum
terbaru.pelajaran: Over an arbitrary commutative ring $R$, we develop a theory of quantum cellular automata.

terbaru.judul: Inefficiency of the block approximation in diploid Probabilistic Cellular Automata
terbaru.pelajaran: We study a probabilistic cellular automaton obtained as a mixture of the additive elementary rules 60 and 102.

terbaru.judul: Remarks on non-invertible symmetries on a tensor product Hilbert space in 1+1 dimensions
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose an index of non-invertible symmetry operators in 1+1 dimensions and discuss its relation to the realizability of non-invertible symmetries on the tensor product of finite dimensional on-site Hilbert spaces on the lattice.

terbaru.judul: A categorical framework for cellular automata
terbaru.pelajaran: We show that $\mathscr{C}$-cellular automata form a subcategory of $\mathscr{C}$ closed under finite products, and that they satisfy a categorical version of the Curtis-Hedlund-Lyndon theorem.

terbaru.judul: Thermalization in classical systems with discrete phase space
terbaru.pelajaran: We study the emergence of statistical mechanics in isolated classical systems with local interactions and discrete phase spaces.

terbaru.judul: Gliders on the Stranded Cellular Automata Model
terbaru.pelajaran: The Stranded Cellular Automata (SCA) model consists of a grid of cells which can each contain between zero and two strands apiece and two turning rules that control when strands turn and when they cross.

terbaru.judul: Neural-Inspired Multi-Agent Molecular Communication Networks for Collective Intelligence
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce a decentralized network architecture where simple nanomachines interact via a diffusive medium using a threshold-based firing mechanism modeled by Greenberg-Hastings (GH) cellular automata.

terbaru.judul: Revealing Latent Self-Similarity in Cellular Automata via Recursive Gradient Profiling
terbaru.pelajaran: This study introduces a Recursive Gradient Profile Function (RGPF) that assigns grayscale values to newly activated cells according to their generation index, enabling latent self-similar structures to emerge cumulatively in spatial visualizations.

terbaru.judul: Engineering discrete local dynamics in globally driven dual-species atom arrays
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce a method for engineering discrete local dynamics in globally-driven dual-species neutral atom experiments, allowing us to study emergent digital models through uniform analog controls.
